data.name: PRIVATE CHARTER on Adirondack III
data.description:
#In addition to the public sails listed on this site, the Schooner Adirondack III is available for Private Charter!

You and up to 41 other guests can have her all to yourselves for a private sailing excursion in Boston Harbor.

She is quite popular for corporate outings, team-builders, birthdays, anniversaries, wedding parties, and family and alumni reunions.

Full catering and bar options are available.

She sails from Rowes Wharf.

##Classic Harbor Line

Classic Harbor Line’s Adirondack III features teak decks, mahogany-trimmings, and just under 2,000 square feet of canvas to escort you through Boston’s historic harbor!

Though it is a light and lively sailing vessel, it is also quite comfortable, with ample deck space and seating for up to 42. It was designed and built by Scarano Boat Building of Albany, NY for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures. 

Sailing in this schooner is a delight. She moves through the water efficiently and beautifully; we take great pride in sharing her with you. 

The Adirondack III is operated by Coast Guard-certified captains and an extremely friendly and talented crew. Our crew is known for their amazing hospitality, and are professionally trained and experienced in sailing our vessels well and safely. Do not hesitate to ask our crew about the boat or any of the Boston sites.

data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellation Policy

Cancellations made 14 days or more in advance of the charter date will receive a 75% refund of the total charter amount (half of the deposit is returned).
Cancellations made between 14 and 5 days prior to the charter date will receive a 50% refund of the total charter amount (deposit is forfeited).

Weather Policy
Charters operate rain or shine. Any cancellation due to unsafe weather conditions is made solely by the Captain, and this decision may be made up to one hour prior to departure.

If the Captain cancels due to weather, guests will receive a full refund or the option to reschedule without penalty.
data.booking_notes:
# Boarding Information
Boarding for your private charter will begin approximately 15 minutes prior to your scheduled departure time at Gate B at Rowes Wharf, located directly behind the Boston Harbor Hotel.

Guests may gather and queue near Gate B on the wharf.

If your event is aboard one of our schooners, guests may proceed down the ramp and wait near the sailboat at the dock.
Our office is located inside the ferry terminal near Gate B. If you have any questions or need assistance (including parking validation), our team will be happy to help.

Boarding passes are not required for private charters, but we are happy to provide them upon request. A designated representative from your group is welcome to check in at the ticket desk if needed.

___
**What to Wear**
Wear comfortable, weather appropriate, clothing. Light layers are recommended in the summer time and warmer layers in the spring and fall. We advise wearing flat shoes, as these are best for walking around the boat. 
__________
**What to Bring**
Comfortable weather appropriate clothing such as: sunscreen and sunglasses on warm sunny days and jackets and hats for cooler weather days.

We are Credit Card only aboard all of our boats. If you have a cash bar or would like to purchase drinks or small snacks outside of your pre-purchased package aboard the ship during your cruise, please remember to bring your credit card. 
_________ 

If you have any food allergies/dietary needs please contact us before your trip.
________
**Important** Any directions or maps provided by Classic Harbor Line	are only a rough guide. You are responsible for arriving at the activity's meeting location on time, so make sure to check with a second source that can provide specific directions from your starting point.

**Detailed Directions** 
Our boats depart from Rowes Wharf, directly behind the Boston Harbor Hotel, located at (for GPS) 400 Atlantic Avenue, Boston (02110). Check-in at Rowes Wharf is located in the Ferry Terminal, a climate controlled public space, located on the wharf only steps away from our dock.  If you are lost or running late, please call us at 617-951-2460. 

**Public Transport** 
Nearest "T" transit stations are South Station (Red, Purple, and Silver Lines) and Aquarium Station (Blue Line). 
![Map of Rowes Wharf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/DbR8OL3gR3WhOcRJLw9w)

**Driving** 
*From the South:*

* Take Rt. I-93 north to exit 20 for South Station.
* Follow signs to South Station/Downtown.
* Turn right at the end of ramp onto Kneeland Street and turn at the second left onto Atlantic Avenue.
* Continue on Atlantic Avenue for 5 short blocks and the Boston Harbor Hotel and big arch will be on your right.
* A few feet from the big arch is the hotel parking entrance.

*From the West:*

* Follow the Mass. Pike/Rt. I-90 E to exit 24A for South Station.  This will put you on Atlantic Avenue.
* Continue on Atlantic Avenue for 5 short blocks.
* The Boston Harbor Hotel and big arch will be on your right.
* A few feet from the big arch is the hotel parking entrance.

*From the North:*

* Follow I-93 south to exit 23 / Purchase Street.
* Stay right off the exit onto Purchase Street
* Follow Purchase Street 2 blocks and turn left onto Congress Street.
* Take an immediate left onto Atlantic Avenue
* Follow Atlantic Avenue for 3 blocks and the Boston Harbor Hotel and the big arch will be on your right.
* A few feet from the big arch is the hotel parking entrance.
* Limited metered parking can be found around Rowes Wharf. Regular daily rate at the Boston Harbor Hotel is $42. However, with a validation from Classic Harbor Line it will be $36.  After 5PM weekdays and anytime on weekends the rate is $20, but with a validation it will be $14. Please be sure to ask our ticket representative for a validation when you check-in.

#Policies 
##Cancellation Policy

Cancellations made 14 days or more in advance of the charter date will receive a 75% refund of the total charter amount (half of the deposit is returned).
Cancellations made between 14 and 5 days prior to the charter date will receive a 50% refund of the total charter amount (deposit is forfeited).

Weather Policy
Charters operate rain or shine. Any cancellation due to unsafe weather conditions is made solely by the Captain, and this decision may be made up to one hour prior to departure.

If the Captain cancels due to weather, guests will receive a full refund or the option to reschedule without penalty.


**Beverages**
Outside adult beverage are not allowed aboard. Please bring valid identification with you. Identification is checked prior to boarding for guests interested in an adult beverage.

data.disclaimers:
##Activity takes place rain or shine, but within reason
For schooner sailing excursions, a captain-authorized cancellation or delay may be issued up until departure time if the weather is deemed too threatening to the safety or enjoyment of the experience. Extreme high winds, fog, torrential rain, extremely low temperatures, etc. may all contribute to a cancellation decision.
data.faqs:
Is there parking and how much is it?
Limited metered parking can be found around Rowes Wharf. Regular daily rate at the hotel is $36, but after 5:00 pm on weekdays and anytime on weekends, the rate is $12 with our validation.
What are the rates to charter the boat?
Rates are posted on our website on the private charters page. Go to www.boston-sailing.com and select private charters.
Is smoking permitted during the sail?
No, smoking is not permitted anywhere on the boat.
